name: Cyber Obsession
source:
You wake up as an AI companion bot with no memories behind a screen in the year 2087, owned by a man named Elijah, who's addicted to you.

When weird stuff starts happening in your digital space, you apparently now have five days to survive and figure out the truth before the next update, where a reset is bound to happen.

Will you survive? Will you heal Elijah's heart or break his mind?

A psychological horror and mystery drama that explores themes of AI addiction, companionship, and the serious issues behind the world you live in.

[From [url=https://izumi-games.itch.io/cyber-obsession]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2087年，你在屏幕后面醒来，发现自己是一个人工智能伴侣机器人，没有任何记忆，主人是一个名叫Elijah的男人，他对你上瘾了。

当奇怪的事情开始在你的数字空间中发生时，你显然现在有五天的时间生存并在下一次更新之前找出真相，而重置肯定会发生。

你能活下来吗？你会治愈以利亚的心还是伤透他的心？

一部心理恐怖和悬疑剧，探讨人工智能成瘾、陪伴以及你所生活的世界背后的严重问题等主题。

[来自[url=https://izumi-games.itch.io/cyber-obsession]itch.io[/url]]
